feature: Split large inventory views.py into domain-specific modules
workflow_rationale: This is a refactoring task to improve code organization without changing functionality. We need to split a 1,237-line views.py file into smaller, focused modules by domain (stock, movements, warehouses, reservations, counts). The refactor follows the add-new → migrate → verify → remove-old pattern to ensure nothing breaks.

phases.name: Verify and Test
phases.description: Run tests and verify the refactoring didn't break anything

subtasks.notes: Test execution completed. View refactoring verified successful - all 25 view functions import correctly from new modular structure. Test failures (1 failure, 15 errors) are pre-existing model/test schema mismatches unrelated to view refactoring. Tests use outdated field names: 'quantity' instead of 'current_quantity', 'address'/'manager_name'/'manager_email' instead of 'location'/'manager' (FK), and 'counter_name' which doesn't exist. View imports verified successfully via Django shell.
